summary: 18 AI renovation previews: 6 colors × 3 supplied house views. Visual approximations, not calibrated paint predictions.
assumptions: Horizontal lap siding throughout body walls and gables; approximately 6-inch reveal in these illustrations
Existing white trim and gray foundation
Illustrative natural medium-oak front door; exact style and stain are not specified
basePrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: realistic architectural renovation preview for a homeowner's interactive paint comparison.
Image 1 is the edit target: the user's actual house. Preserve this exact photograph's viewpoint, framing, 4:3 aspect ratio, every building outline, window and door location, roof shape, trim proportions, porch geometry, plants, sky, neighbors, foreground objects, perspective, and lighting.
Primary request: finish the visible main house with new smooth horizontal overlapping lap siding, approximately 6-inch exposure. Replace ALL existing yellow/gray body siding and exposed green/blue construction sheathing on THIS house with continuous, neatly installed lap siding, including all gables and the small front porch gable. Paint all these body siding surfaces Sherwin-Williams Acacia Haze SW 9132, a muted gray sage green with digital reference sRGB #969C92. Treat this as the material's neutral paint color; retain the original photo's believable direct sun, deep porch shade, and cast shadows rather than making every pixel a flat swatch.
Keep existing white fascia, soffits, gutters, brackets, beams, corner boards, porch columns, railings and window/door casings white, precisely in their original places. Keep the gray foundation, roofing, brick, stone and neighboring homes unchanged.
If the front door is visible, replace only its dark surface with a tasteful natural medium-oak wood door with subtle vertical grain, retaining its exact opening, proportions, hardware position and glazed area. Do not introduce an extra door if none is visible.
No redesign. No new windows. Do not remove or relocate tools, ladders or landscaping. Do not beautify or change the weather. Do not brighten the shaded facade artificially. No labels, captions, swatch blocks, collage or borders. Output one edited photo filling the entire frame, aligned as closely as possible with the original.
